draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.84, the 195th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 29th of 35 at WR. He went 219th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing concerns: 20-yard shuttle (10th percentile), three-cone (14th percentile). College production: 760 receiving yards in 2020, 14th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.
